appraisal_events.evidence: les parents de Gilberte, qui si longtemps m'avaient empêché de la voir, ... me serraient la main en souriant et me disaient : Gilberte sait-elle que vous êtes là ?; les goûters ... devenaient maintenant une occasion de nous réunir; Gilberte ne consultait pas seulement sa faim; elle s'informait encore de la mienne.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator, once kept from seeing Gilberte, is now warmly welcomed by her parents and personally folded into her private gatherings, where she attends to his comfort; the passage marks a clear shift from exclusion to valued inclusion in the Swann household.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator moves from being barred from Gilberte's presence to being openly welcomed into the intimate rituals of the Swann household's private life.
Entering this now-accessible world produces an intoxicating rapture in the narrator, described as overwhelming his ordinary awareness and memory.
